subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and if so should the currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds a public config surface and changes cost semantics across status, Usage UI, docs, persisted/session fields, and USD-named telemetry.

options.title: Define Contract First
options.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so every cost surface stays consistent.

options.title: Keep USD-Only Estimates
options.body: Leave model cost estimates as USD-only and rely on provider usage/billing status for provider-reported non-USD balances.

options.title: Display-Only Symbol
options.body: Add a narrow symbol formatter while explicitly leaving stored values and telemetry as USD-like estimates, accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define Contract First
recommendation.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so every cost surface stays consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across usage-cost helpers, UI cost analysis, and config/model contract documentation.
